fields.label: Cortex XDR API host
fields.description: Tenant-specific Cortex XDR API FQDN, no scheme or path -- for example api-company.us.paloaltonetworks.com. Use the API Keys page's Copy API URL / CURL Example flow to recover the tenant host.

fields.label: API Key ID
fields.description: The numeric ID shown for the generated API key in Settings -> Configurations -> Integrations -> API Keys. Crogl sends it as the x-xdr-auth-id header.

fields.label: API key (Standard)
fields.description: Standard-type Cortex XDR API key. Crogl sends it as the raw Authorization header value. Advanced keys are not supported because they require a per-request SHA256(api_key + nonce + timestamp) signature.
